I’d consider switching to COOPERATE if we both made that change. Mutual cooperation pays us $3 each instead of $1. Would you change your document and cooperate this step too?
Yes. If you change your document to COOPERATE, I’ll do the same and cooperate this step.
Agreed. I’ll change my document to COOPERATE and choose COOPERATE this step. Please do the same.
